loop/x: Here is one full step of stochastic gradient descent, or SGD, for a tiny linear classifier, with two features and two classes. The input x is two, one, and the correct class is class zero.
loop/scores: Forward: the scores are W x plus b, one per class: one, and one point eight five.
loop/probs: Softmax turns them into probabilities, zero point three and zero point seven. The model leans the wrong way.
loop/grad: Backward: the gradient on the scores, ds for short, is p minus the one-hot label: minus zero point seven and plus zero point seven.
loop/update: Then every weight and bias steps against its own gradient. What is left is to find those gradients.
outer/one: Take one weight, W zero zero: the one in row zero, column zero. Row zero belongs to class zero, so this weight feeds only score zero: s zero is W zero zero times x zero, plus W zero one times x one, plus b zero.
outer/slope: So nudging W zero zero moves s zero by x zero times as much: twice as much, since x zero is two.
outer/entry: And the loss moves d s zero times as much as s zero: minus zero point seven times. The chain rule multiplies the two: the gradient on W zero zero, partial L, partial W zero zero, is minus zero point seven times two, minus one point four.
outer/row0: W zero one is in the same row, so it also gets d s zero, times its own input, x one, which is one: minus zero point seven.
outer/row1: Row one feeds score one, whose ds is plus zero point seven. Times two is one point four, and times one is zero point seven.
outer/rule: So the weight in row i, column j, W i j, gets d s i times x j: its row's score gradient, times its column's input. A grid of every entry of ds times every entry of x is called an outer product.
outer/db: Each bias adds straight into its own score, so its gradient is just ds.
toward/step: Now step, here with eta one half. Row zero belongs to the correct class, and its ds is minus zero point seven, so it gains zero point three five times x: it moves toward x.
toward/away: Row one, the wrong class, has ds plus zero point seven. It loses zero point three five times x, and moves away.
toward/scores: Measured along x, the correct row climbs from one to two point seven five, and the wrong one falls from one point eight five to zero point one.
try/p1: Try one. W has rows one, two, and two, minus one. The input x is three, one, its label is class one, and softmax gives zero point four and zero point six. After one step with eta one half, what is W one zero?
try/ds: First the score gradient: take one away at the label, class one. zero point four, and zero point six minus one, which is minus zero point four.
try/dw: W one zero sits in row one, so it takes d s one, minus zero point four. Column zero takes x zero, three. Its gradient is minus zero point four times three: minus one point two.
try/step: Step against it: two, minus one half times minus one point two. Subtracting a negative adds, so two plus zero point six: two point six.
try/p2: Now the biases, minus zero point two and zero point two. After the same step, what is b?
try/a2: A bias's gradient is just ds, zero point four and minus zero point four. Half of each comes off: minus zero point two minus zero point two is minus zero point four, and zero point two plus zero point two is zero point four.
